text:
maria.marketing: Hey @ajay.runtime @sam.dex — quick ask from marketing. We want to use a hero stat in the launch post that says "up to 2x inference cost savings vs baseline" for a realistic web chat workload. Can eng/runtime run a compact sanity bench so we can validate and lock phrasing? Need p50/p95 token latencies and an estimated $/1k-token compute cost for a small set of configs.

ajay.runtime: Sure. Can you give exact model, sample prompts, seq len, and the three configs you want compared? Also confirm concurrency target and whether we should include quantized variants.

maria.marketing: Model: open-gen-7b-v1 (use the version in the catalog). Seq len: 512. Sample prompts: short chat turns (~30 tokens) and a longer 2-turn convo (~350 tokens). Attachments: two example payloads below. Please run: hosted-standard (prod settings), hosted-quantized-fp4, dedicated-small (reserved pool, same model). Target concurrency: 4. Please do p50/p95 and cost estimates. For marketing copy we need clear labels: baseline=no-cache hosted-standard, quantized=fp4 hosted.

Sample payloads:
```
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hi, summarize my notes about today's meeting and list next steps."}]}
```
```
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"I had a two-turn chat: first prompt ~300 tokens asking for a product spec, then a follow-up clarifying constraints."}]}
```

ajay.runtime: OK — I'll do a smoke run. Plan: 3 concurrencies (1,4,8) but we'll report the 4 concurrency numbers for the doc. Limit to ~30 samples per config to keep it fast. Important: do a no-cache baseline plus a prefix-KV-cache enabled variant; caching changes p95 a lot. Also run the quantized variant if the model registry has a verified fp4 build.

sam.dex: Add a note to include model-version string and commit hash in the results. Also flag if any tail queuing occurred. For the dedicated run, please run on the same gpu class we expect for dedicated (a100-small) so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

jen.docs: I'll review the draft claim language after you post raw numbers. For public-facing copy we probably need "typical workloads" hedging and explicit footnote about test configs. Put the raw CSV and the runtime job link in the thread.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job queued: id=run-20250301-842, queued by ajay.runtime, ETA ~2h.

maria.marketing: Awesome, thanks. Can you also include a short bullet we can paste into the PR: inputs (seq len, tokens/sample), exact command used, and a single-row summary table we can screenshot?

ajay.runtime: Yep. Command I'll run for reproducibility:
```bash
redwood-bench run --model open-gen-7b-v1 --seq-len 512 --concurrency 4 --samples 30 --cache {on,off} --variant {fp16,fp4} --env {hosted,dedicated} --out csv --job-id run-20250301-842
```

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job started: id=run-20250301-842 on pool=a100-small.

ajay.runtime: Running now. Will post quick CSV + a 1-paragraph narrative summary when done.

sam.dex: Quick ask: please also capture tokens/sec and p50/p95 for the embedding requests (if you have the embed pipeline handy) — we'll avoid embedding numbers in the hero but might need them for detailed appendix.

maria.marketing: Noted — embeddings are optional but helpful. If it adds >30m, skip.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job complete: id=run-20250301-842. Results: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/run-20250301-842 (CSV and JSON artifacts).

ajay.runtime: Results summary (4-concurrency, seq=512, 30 samples each):
- hosted-standard (no-cache): p50=120ms per-token, p95=350ms per-token, tokens/sec=75, est cost=$0.18/1k tokens
- hosted-standard (cache-enabled): p50=40ms, p95=90ms, tokens/sec=220, est cost=$0.07/1k tokens
- hosted-quantized-fp4: p50=80ms, p95=190ms, tokens/sec=120, est cost=$0.10/1k tokens
- dedicated-small (a100-small): p50=60ms, p95=150ms, tokens/sec=160, est cost=$0.09/1k tokens
Model version: open-gen-7b-v1@sha256:abc123def. No significant queuing observed. CSV upload: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/run-20250301-842/results.csv

maria.marketing: This is perfect — thanks. For the hero copy we'll use: "Up to ~2.6x token-per-second improvement with our cache-enabled path vs baseline hosted-standard on the same model." Jen, can you confirm phrasing?

jen.docs: That phrasing is OK but change "~2.6x" to "up to 2.5x" and add a footnote: "Measurements based on internal benchmark run-20250301-842; results may vary by workload and model version." I'll add to the PR.

maria.marketing: Great. Ajay — can you drop the single-row summary table as an image (png) and the CSV into the PR? We'll schedule social copy after legal signs off.

ajay.runtime: Will do. PNG + CSV uploaded to the job artifacts; posting links in the PR now. Will also pin this thread.

maria.marketing: Thanks all — this is exactly what we needed. :tada:
